at 2026-08-10T12:00:00Z

mkdir project-edit
cd project-edit
exec card init --prefix root- --board-name 'Root board'
exec card project create Secondary --prefix secondary-
exec card --json board create --project project_11111111111111111111 'Secondary board'

# Name selection returns the authoritative committed project state.
exec card --json project edit Secondary --name 'Renamed project'
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/renamed-project.json

# The rename preserves board membership and project issue configuration.
exec card --json board list
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/boards.jsonl
exec card --board board_11111111111111111111 create 'Configured issue'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/configured-issue.txt

# Stable identity selection supports human output, and a repeated edit is a no-op.
exec card project edit project_11111111111111111111 --name 'Final project'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/final-project.txt
exec card --json project edit project_11111111111111111111 --name 'Final project'
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/final-project.json

# Invalid input leaves the committed project unchanged.
! exec card project edit project_11111111111111111111 --name ' '
! stdout .
stderr 'project name required'
exec card --json project edit project_11111111111111111111 --name 'Final project'
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/final-project.json

# Duplicate names remain valid, while selecting an ambiguous name requires an ID.
exec card project create 'Final project'
! exec card project edit 'Final project' --name Ambiguous
! stdout .
stderr 'project "Final project" is ambiguous; use an ID'
exec card --json project edit project_22222222222222222222 --name 'Final project'
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/duplicate-project.json
